shadows.name: court-illustration
shadows.purpose: Separate the tilted court illustration from the paper background.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Elevate the authentication dialog above its scrim.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.value: background .16s ease, color .16s ease, transform .16s ease

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The main create or save action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--court); color: var(--white); font: 700 1rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--court-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ball); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline action
components.description: A secondary action, including spectator navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid #9bb7a5; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--court-dark); font: 700 1rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--soft); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ball); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A readable tournament search or form field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 700 .88rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #c6d4ca; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ball); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live match row
components.description: A public tournament in progress, with its current volleyball score.
components.html:
Vôlei de sábadoAo vivo
Equipe azul21 : 19Equipe verde
components.css: .ds-live-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 15px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-live-row strong { display: block; font: 700 1rem 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-live-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--court-dark); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-live-state i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #cf493d; } .ds-match-score { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .91rem; } .ds-match-score b { color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.05rem; }

components.name: Tournament header
components.description: Keeps the selected tournament name and state visible above match controls.
components.css: .ds-tournament-header { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 19px 22px; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; background: var(--court-dark); color: var(--white); font: 700 1.35rem 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-tournament-header span { color: #d8e9dd; font: 600 .82rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Court green, chalk-white surfaces, dark score ink, and a warm volleyball accent create a clear match-day interface. The home page leads with creating or watching a volleyball tournament, then shows the live match list.
keyCharacteristics: Two primary actions on the home screen.
Tournament setup appears only after the create action.
Score and tournament state remain text-first and legible.

rules.name: The Match-Day Rule
rules.body: Amber belongs to the ball illustration; green owns primary actions.

rules.name: The Score First Rule
rules.body: Team names and score precede supporting metadata.

dos: Do keep the home page focused on creating or watching volleyball tournaments.
Do keep score and match state readable without relying on color alone.
donts: Don't add decorative KPI cards or generic sports analytics to the home screen.
Don't show tournament setup fields before the create action.
